changelog.0.2.0: fine-tune the pretrained MONAI BTCV SwinUNETR (swin_unetr_btcv_segmentation 0.5.8) instead of training UNETR from scratch
changelog.0.1.0: UNETR for SegTHOR thoracic organs at risk, adapted from the MONAI segmentation template 0.0.4

name: SegTHOR SwinUNETR Segmentation
task: 3D segmentation of thoracic organs at risk in CT
description: SwinUNETR initialised from the MONAI BTCV abdominal multi-organ bundle (huggingface.co/MONAI/swin_unetr_btcv_segmentation) and fine-tuned on 96x96x96 patches of SegTHOR CT volumes resampled to 1.5x1.5x2.0 mm and windowed to [-175, 250] HU, as for the pretrained model. Segments the esophagus, heart, trachea and aorta; the esophagus and aorta outputs start from the corresponding BTCV classes. Whole volumes are segmented with sliding window inference and mapped back to the original CT space.
references: Hatamizadeh et al., Swin UNETR: Swin Transformers for Semantic Segmentation of Brain Tumors in MRI Images, 2022
Tang et al., Self-Supervised Pre-Training of Swin Transformers for 3D Medical Image Analysis, CVPR 2022
